module.purpose: Creates and configures the Svelte Flow store, exposing state-management actions for nodes, edges, viewport control, selection, dragging, connections, and layout updates.
module.summary: This module composes the initial Svelte Flow store with imperative actions. It delegates graph and viewport calculations to system utilities, updates reactive store state, manages node and edge selection, handles connection lifecycle, applies drag and keyboard movement, and coordinates deferred viewport fitting after node internals change.
module.businessContext: Supports interactive node-based diagram editing and visualization. Failures can prevent users from selecting, moving, connecting, or correctly displaying graph elements.

units.name: handleEdgeSelection

detail.name: handleEdgeSelection
detail.signature: function handleEdgeSelection({ id, edge, selectable }: { id: string; edge: Edge; selectable: boolean })

parameters.name: { id, edge, selectable }
parameters.type: { id: string; edge: Edge; selectable: boolean }

preconditions: The input provides an edge identifier, an edge object, and a selectable flag.
postconditions: If the edge is selectable, the selection rectangle and its mode are cleared.
If a selectable edge was unselected, it is added to the selected edges.
If a selectable edge was selected and multiselection is active, it is removed from selection.
invariants: Non-selectable edges do not change edge or selection-rectangle state.
A selected edge is not deselected unless the multiselection key is pressed.
edgeCases: When selectable is false, the function performs no selection update.
When selectable is true and the edge is unselected, the edge is selected.
When selectable is true, the edge is selected, and multiselection is inactive, the edge remains selected.
When selectable is true, the edge is selected, and multiselection is active, the edge is deselected.
stateMutations: selectionRect is set to null for selectable edges.
selectionRectMode is set to null for selectable edges.
Selected-edge state is updated through addSelectedEdges or unselectNodesAndEdges.
detail.summary: Handles selection changes for an edge. Selectable unselected edges are selected, while selected edges are deselected only when multiselection is active.

specTests.then: The selection rectangle and selection-rectangle mode are cleared, and the edge is added to the selected edges.

specTests.when: handleEdgeSelection is called for the edge.
specTests.then: The selection rectangle and selection-rectangle mode are cleared, and the edge is removed from selection.

specTests.when: handleEdgeSelection is called for the edge.
specTests.then: No selection state or selection-rectangle state is changed.

units.name: moveSelectedNodes

detail.name: moveSelectedNodes
detail.signature: function moveSelectedNodes({ x: xDiff, y: yDiff }: XYPosition)
preconditions: The input contains numeric x and y displacement components.
The store has initialized node lookup and node-position configuration.
postconditions: Each eligible selected node has its position and absolute internal position updated by the requested displacement, subject to snapping and position constraints.
A node-position update is submitted for the nodes processed by the operation.
invariants: Nodes that are not selected are not moved.
Selected nodes are moved only when draggable, or when draggability is unspecified and nodesDraggable is enabled.
The node's relative position and absolute internal position are updated from the result of calculateNodePosition.
The original node identity and node id are preserved.
edgeCases: When no nodes are eligible for movement, no node positions are changed and the update operation receives no node changes.
When snapGrid is configured, each candidate absolute position is snapped before position constraints are calculated.
When a selected node has draggable set to false, it is skipped.
When a selected node has draggable undefined, it is moved only if nodesDraggable is true.
Position-calculation errors are delegated to the configured onerror callback.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: No explicit validation or fallback is performed by this function; position calculation and its onerror callback handle node-position errors.

stateMutations: Mutates each eligible node's position field.
Mutates each eligible node's internals.positionAbsolute field.
Submits the collected node changes through the store's node-position update mechanism.
detail.summary: Moves all currently selected and draggable nodes by the supplied x/y delta. Positions are optionally snapped to the configured grid and constrained through the store's node-position calculation before updates are applied.

specTests.then: The candidate position is snapped to the configured grid before constrained position values are assigned to the node.
